title: Reading Decisions Before Spans: Efficient Generative Verification
abstract: arXiv:2611.32931v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A developer checking an assistant's report may need only an alarm that a claim is unsupported. A generative verifier, however, can continue decoding to quote and classify the errors. We study how much of that output is needed to recover its decision. In a frozen 2B span verifier, the choice between an empty error list and its first object precedes all localization. Native8 stops generation at this branch. The preceding seven syntax tokens are fixed, so Prefill1 supplies them as input and generates only the unrestricted branch token, using the same native instruction. On 2,015 code-agent TEST responses, Prefill1 reduces eager resident service by 84.84% relative to full generation, with released-reference F1 of 83.43 versus 83.41. It saves 31.98% over Native8 even though their logical token totals are identical. Under default compiled execution, the extra saving is 6.74-26.73% on the complete workload, with small decision changes. Controll

translated_title: 先于跨度读取决策：高效的生成式验证
translated_abstract: 开发者在检查智能助手生成的报告时，可能只需要一条关于某项声明缺乏依据的警报。然而，生成式验证器可以继续解码以引用并分类这些错误。我们研究了需要多少这样的输出才能恢复其决策。在一个冻结的20亿参数（2B）跨度验证器中，“空错误列表”与“第一个错误对象”之间的选择发生在所有错误定位之前。Native8在该分支处停止生成。由于其前面的七个语法标记是固定的，Prefill1将它们作为输入进行预填充，并仅生成一个不受限制的分支标记，且使用相同的原生指令。在2,015个代码智能体TEST响应上，相对于完整生成，Prefill1将eager常驻服务开销减少了84.84%，其released-reference F1为83.43（完整生成为83.41）。尽管二者逻辑标记总数相同，Prefill1仍比Native8节省了31.98%。在默认编译执行下，在整个工作负载上额外节省了6.74%至26.73%，且决策变化很小。
tldr: 提出Prefill1方法：利用生成式验证器的决策先于错误跨度定位、且决策分支前七个语法标记固定的特点，通过预填充固定标记并仅生成一个分支标记即可恢复验证决策，相比完整生成减少84.84%的服务开销且F1几乎不变。
en_tdlr: Prefill1 exploits the fact that a generative verifier's decision precedes its error span localization, prefilling the seven fixed syntax tokens and generating only the single unrestricted branch token to recover the decision, reducing eager resident service by 84.84% versus full generation with nearly unchanged F1.
